# AVI-SPL  Symphony

Monitor and analyze your multi-vendor

meeting experiences and environments.

Scroll to bottom of the hero section

![AVI-SPL Epson Symphony driven meeting](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/AVISPL_Epson-Sympony.jpg)

### Enhance User Experience

Technology innovations happen quickly. Having visibility across your future-ready workplace, providing the meeting experience users expect, is central to your IT and AV teams. Symphony makes it easier to keep your environment healthy.

[Book a Demo](https://avispl.com/symphony/#request_a_demo)

### AVI-SPL Symphony    in Action

### The one meeting monitoring platform that brings it all together.

![flow chart icon](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/symphony-icons_symphony-3.svg)

#### Unified view

Symphony consolidates UC system performance and meeting room usage data from all connected devices and vendor-specific management tools into one source of truth.

![Cog icon](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/symphony-icons_native-integration.svg)

#### Native integration

Symphony syncs with the same tools your end-users and IT services team already rely on, including MS Exchange/O365 and ServiceNow.

![rotating cog icon](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/symphony-icons_symphony-4.svg)

#### Workflow automation

Symphony auto-detects issues, automates ticket creation, and enables IT users to automate technology management routines.

![tick in a shield icon](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/symphony-icons_symphony-5.svg)

#### Actionable intelligence

Symphony tracks how meeting spaces are used and how technology performs for meaningful data about space capacity, technology condition, and collaboration adoption.

![Server security icon](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/symphony-icons_secure-ecosystem.svg)

#### Secure ecosystem

Symphony operates on secure and encrypted connections. Whether on a shared multi-tenant environment or your own individual cloud instance, your data is protected.

## ManageandAnalyzeTechnology-EnabledSpaces

Symphony manages and analyzes technology-enabled spaces in one efficient platform, no matter the vendor. You can easily see and understand what is happening across your collaboration ecosystem and quickly prevent and act on issues. The key areas of Symphony include:

- ###### Asset Capture




Know what is deployed where, including furniture assets, understand deployment makeup and works in progress, and prepare for budgetary planning.

- ###### Cloud Migration




Bring together AV, video conferencing, and unified communications collaboration.

- ###### Centralized Monitoring




Communicate with technology 24 hours a day, when people can’t.

- ###### Meeting Measurement




Validate your investment in spaces and technology by understanding utilization, quality, and user impact.

- ###### Incident Management




Auto-create, clear and close tickets for the technical resource, based on the values that make sense to your organization.

- ###### Workplace Management




Survey assets, trouble spots, space utilization, and technical resources allocation.

- ###### Success Metrics




Quickly analyze data and make it visually digestible. Symphony provides account and location level benchmarking, time-stamped snapshots of health metrics, and estate statistics.
